name: Godstouched
body:
Gods gave you a sign of their favor, and at the same time a trial.

Benefit: Select an oracle’s curse you don’t already possess.

You gain all effects of the curse, treating your effective oracle level as equal to 1/2 your character level. If the curse grants spells to add to the oracle’s known spells list, you instead gain these spells as spell-like abilities usable once per day.
